notes.text: Hartford Fire Insurance Company: Prepared a request to join its workers’ compensation MPN, highlighting APA’s behavioral health services and nearby Southern California locations while requesting confirmation of eligible locations and participation requirements.

PRISM MPN: Prepared a participation request highlighting APA’s Folsom, Roseville, Sacramento, Elk Grove, and Auburn locations and requesting confirmation of service-area eligibility and enrollment requirements

Sentry Insurance Company: Prepared an MPN participation request highlighting APA’s Sacramento-area locations and requesting confirmation of eligible offices, credentialing requirements, and network participation procedures
HealthComp: Prepared a provider contracting inquiry exploring direct contracting or participation through its PPO and network partners.
Key Benefit Administrators (KBA): Prepared a provider agreement request asking about direct contracting, external network partnerships, eligible employer plans, and credentialing requirements.

Midwest General Insurance Agency, LLC: Prepared a workers’ compensation provider partnership inquiry highlighting APA’s California presence and requesting information on eligible locations and contracting requirements.

PacFed Benefit Administrators: Prepared a TPA partnership inquiry highlighting APA’s nearby West Covina, Encino, Torrance, and Long Beach locations and exploring direct contracting or participation through existing health plan networks.

Iora Health NE DCE, LLC (One Medical ACO REACH / Iora Health Network): Researched its California presence and prepared a partnership request emphasizing APA’s potential role in providing behavioral health services to eligible Medicare beneficiaries. Identified potential locations in Los Angeles, Orange County, San Diego, and the San Francisco Bay Area, subject to service-area confirmation.

Live Well IPA: Researched its Rancho Mirage location and Southern California presence, then prepared a participation request highlighting APA’s Riverside, San Bernardino, Rancho Cucamonga, and Corona locations, subject to network eligibility confirmation.

Medical Home Network Health Alliance II, LLC: Prepared an ACO partnership inquiry requesting confirmation of California eligibility, geographic coverage, and behavioral health provider participation requirements
Karewell Health IPA: Created a provider roster to support the contracting process.
One Medical: Submitted the enrollment form through its website.
HealthSCOPE Benefits: Validated the contact information and removed the lead from the invalid leads list.
Vanity: Prepared a follow-up email requesting the remaining new hire paperwork needed to finalize onboarding and credentialing.
